claim: A Chinese methodological question about what covariance non-stationarity means in spatial transcriptomics is decisively answered by one English bioRxiv preprint that actually quantifies it (3%-50% of genes across 13 Visium datasets); the Chinese-language web only has generic spatial-transcriptomics tutorials.

args.query: 空间转录组里协方差的非平稳性到底说明了什么

verification.evidence_snippet: Covariance Nonstationarity is Evident in Spatial Transcriptomics and Provides a New Categorization of Spatially Varying Genes: 'Across 13 Visium datasets, we use approximate Bayes factors from R-INLA to compare stationary and non-stationary Matern covariance functions. Evidence for covariance non-stationarity appears in 3% to 50% of genes across tissue samples.'
